command:
git status --short && printf '
--- diff stat ---
' && git diff --stat && printf '
--- staged stat ---
' && git diff --cached --stat

git diff -- AGENTS.md && printf '
--- deleted paths ---
' && git diff --name-status && printf '
--- recent commits ---
' && git log -5 --oneline --decorate
printf '%s\n' '--- root ---'; ls -la; printf '%s\n' '--- tracked top-level ---'; git ls-tree --name-only HEAD
